definitions.gloss: finally, at last, in the end
definitions.explanation: After a long time or much effort, something finally happens. Often implies the speaker has been waiting for or expecting this outcome.

examples.japanese: とうとう⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{叶|かな}いました→叶う：05303_kanau⟧。
とうとう⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}り→降る：00839_furu⟧⟦{始|はじ}めました→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
とうとう⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来|こ}なかった→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: In the end, he didn't come.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦{待|ま}って→待つ：00469_matsu⟧、とうとう⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}ました→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: After waiting a long time, the bus finally came.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}して→練習する：05323_renshuu⟧、とうとう⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{弾|ひ}ける→弾く：02444_hiku⟧⟦ように→ように：10081_youni⟧⟦なりました→なる：01970_naru⟧。⟦{本当|ほんとう}に→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦うれしい→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: After practicing many times, I was finally able to play this song. I'm really happy.

notes:
とうとう indicates that something finally happened after a long wait or process, often with a sense of inevitability.

WRITING:
Usually written in hiragana. The kanji form {到頭|とうとう} exists but is rarely used.

CONTRAST WITH ⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧:
- とうとう: finally (positive or negative, sense of inevitability)
- ⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧: finally (usually positive, relief after effort)

EXAMPLES:
- とうとう⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{叶|かな}った→叶う：05303_kanau⟧: My dream finally came true (positive)
- とうとう⟦{来|こ}なかった→来る：00254_kuru⟧: In the end, they didn't come (negative)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧: finally, at last (relief)
- ⟦{遂|つい}に→遂に：02360_tsuini⟧: finally, at last (more formal)
- ⟦{結局|けっきょく}→結局：03815_kekkyoku⟧: in the end, after all
